Code

For these analysis we are going to do some key validations and analyses.

  • Run variant calling on 10x flex data to quantify the sequencing error rate at varying read depths.
    • Data from https://www.10xgenomics.com/datasets/40k-mixture-of-cells-dissociated-from-4-fixed-mouse-tissues-using-manual-dissociation-multiplexed-samples-4-probe-barcodes-1-standard
  • Analyze samples where the tumor cells express a marker that allows us to know which cells should be called as tumor and then assess accuracy of the method.
    • S0105 - K7M2-RFP tibia tumor
    • S0122 - K7M2 sLPmCherry lung mets 10 days post injection. Flow sorted Cherry positive fraction 1:1:1 mix of CD45+, Epcam+ and double negative
    • GSE247228 - lentiviral green fluorescent protein (GFP) in melanoma cells
    • GSE201615 - Cas9 in soft-tissue sarcoma cells, also dsRED
    • S0260 - barcoded F420 tumor samples
    • S0261 - barcoded F420 tumor sample
  • Analyze samples from genetically distinct mouse strains where we know how the clustering should look.
    • S0066 - B6 lung
    • S0074 - Balb/c lung
  • Analyze mouse OS models where the tumor cells derive from the host mouse strain to simulate a genetic divergence more expected in patients.
    • S0066 - (control) B6 lung
    • S0067 - B6, F420 injected, lungs from ROB 273 A, B, D; Epcam postive:negative 1:1
    • S0068 - B6, F420 injected, lungs from ROB 273E and ROB 274A; Epcam postive:negative 1:1
    • S0074 - (control) Balb/c lung
    • S0075 - Balb/c, K7M2 injected, lungs; Epcam postive:negative 1:1
    • S0105 - K7M2-RFP tibia tumor
    • S0200 - (control) F420 cellculture p17
    • S0201 - (control) K7M2 cellculture p17
    • S0246 - F420 lung mets and niche cells ctrl
    • S0259 - (control) F420, barcoded, preinjection t0 ctrl
    • S0260 - barcoded F420 tumor samples
    • S0261 - barcoded F420 tumor sample
  • Assess scanBit results when run on human patient tumor samples.
    • GSE152048 OS samples
    • GSE162454 OS samples
    • GSE210358 prostate cancer samples
    • GSE222703 renal cell carcinoma samples
    • GSE169396 bone samples
    • GSE237579 healthy PBMC samples

Download raw data from GEO/SRA, process it and re-align Roberts lab data to GFP/RFP reference

This also downloads the flex data from 10x

The output here will be cellrange counts folders in output/cellranger_out/

The metadata for all samples is stored in misc/sample_metadata.tsv.

Note that in the sample_metadata, for samples with multiple references, the cutoff format is “GRCh38-40000;mm10—20000” where the species_pattern is at the beginning of the string, followed by the cutoff value (no dash or anything). This is split from the second cutoff value by a semicolon. If there is only one reference, just use the cutoff value, no species pattern is needed.

source("analysis_modules/01_process_raw/01_helper_functions.R")

n_geo_samples=$(grep -v geo_id misc/validation_geo_metadata.tsv | wc -l)

n_geo_samples=$((n_geo_samples - 1))

sbatch \
  --array=0-${n_geo_samples}%20 \
  analysis_modules/01_process_raw/scripts/get_geo_fastqs.sh

Prep known tumor cells to add to SingleR ref

Code
culture_ref_samples <-
    read_tsv(
        "misc/mouse_samples_Roberts_metadata.tsv",
        show_col_types = FALSE
    ) %>%
    filter(Tissue == "cell culture") %>%
    pull(Sample_ID)

tumor_refs <-
    lapply(
        culture_ref_samples,
        function(x) {
            set.seed(1337)
            sobj <- qs2::qs_read(paste0(
                "output/01_process_raw/rdata/individual/",
                x,
                "_mouse.qs2"
            )) %>%
                subset(downsample = 500)

            return(
                list(
                    sce = as.SingleCellExperiment(sobj),
                    labels = rep("Tumor", ncol(sobj))
                )
            )
        }
    )

qs2::qs_save(tumor_refs, "output/01_process_raw/rdata/merged/mouse_tumor_refs.qs2")

source("analysis_modules/02_snv_calling/02_helper_functions.R")

Prep the flex data

We’re going to run scanBit on a merged object for this so the data all ends up in one BCF file. ::: {.cell}

Code
flex_samples <-
    read_tsv("misc/flex_metadata.tsv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    pull(Sample_ID)

flex_sobj_list <-
    lapply(
        flex_samples,
        function(this_sample) {
            qs_read(paste0(
                "output/01_process_raw/rdata/individual/",
                this_sample,
                "_mouse.qs2"
            ))
        }
    )

merged_flex <-
    merge(flex_sobj_list[[1]], flex_sobj_list[-1]) %>%
    process_seurat()

merged_flex$cell_group <-
    paste0(
        merged_flex$cluster_label,
        "_c",
        merged_flex$individ_clusters
    )

flex_dimplot <-
    (DimPlot(
        merged_flex,
        group.by = "Name",
        label = TRUE,
        label.box = TRUE,
        label.size = 2,
        repel = TRUE,
        ncol = 1
    ) +
        NoLegend()) +
    (DimPlot(
        merged_flex,
        group.by = "cell_group",
        label = TRUE,
        label.box = TRUE,
        label.size = 2,
        repel = TRUE,
        ncol = 1
    ) +
        NoLegend()) +
    (DimPlot(
        merged_flex,
        group.by = "cell_type",
        label = TRUE,
        label.box = TRUE,
        label.size = 2,
        repel = TRUE,
        ncol = 1
    ) +
        NoLegend())

ggsave(
    "output/02_snv_calling/figures/dimplot_flex_cell_type_group.pdf",
    flex_dimplot,
    width = 10,
    height = 20
)

flex_cell_barcode_group_table <-
    merged_flex@meta.data %>%
    select(cell_group, cell_barcode, bam_file) %>%
    as_tibble()

Run scanBit on the flex data

Code
# This was erroring out because there aren't enough snvs
# I lowered min_snvs_per_cluster to 5 to try to get it to work
snp_tree <-
    get_snp_tree(
        cellid_bam_table = flex_cell_barcode_group_table,
        ploidy = "mm10",
        output_dir = "output/02_snv_calling/snv/flex/",
        temp_dir = "output/02_snv_calling/snv/flex/tempdir",
        output_base_name = "flex_snvs",
        ref_fasta = "/reference/mus_musculus/mm10/ucsc_assmebly/illumina_download/Sequence/WholeGenomeFasta/genome.fa",
        min_depth = c(1, 5, 10, 20, 30),
        job_base = "flex_sbatch",
        log_base = "slurmOut/flex_snv",
        min_snvs_per_cluster = 5,
        n_bootstraps = 10000,
        max_prop_missing_at_site = 0.9,
        tree_image_type = "pdf",
        cleanup = FALSE,
        other_job_header_options = c(
            "--time=8:00:00",
            "--partition=himem,general"
        ),
        other_batch_options = c(
            "ml purge"
        ),
        use_apptainer = TRUE,
        allow_chr_mismatch = TRUE # there are some junk contigs in there
    )

Prep the mouse samples to run scanBit

We’re going to merge all of these data together so the output is one big tree. We’ll break it down further later on. ::: {.cell}

Code
mouse_samples <-
    read_tsv(
        "misc/mouse_samples_Roberts_metadata.tsv",
        show_col_types = FALSE
    ) %>%
    pull(Sample_ID) %>%
    c(
        read_tsv(
            "misc/mouse_samples_Roberts_realign_metadata.tsv",
            show_col_types = FALSE
        ) %>%
            pull(Sample_ID)
    )

mouse_sobj_list <-
    lapply(
        mouse_samples,
        function(this_sample) {
            qs_read(paste0(
                "output/01_process_raw/rdata/individual/",
                this_sample,
                "_mouse.qs2"
            ))
        }
    )
names(mouse_sobj_list) <- mouse_samples

# With the clustering I did initially, S0067 had a cluster that was roughly
# 50/50 tumor normal and it messes up the whole F420/B6 tree
# This is a good example of how important good clustering is to get this to work
# I renamed the original tree plots with _orig.pdf to maybe show in supplement
# Reclustering so this mixed cluster is split fixes the issue

mouse_sobj_list$S0067 <-
    mouse_sobj_list$S0067 %>%
    process_seurat(resolution = 0.25)

mouse_sobj_list$S0067$individ_clusters <- mouse_sobj_list$S0067$seurat_clusters
mouse_sobj_list$S0067$cell_group <-
    paste0(
        mouse_sobj_list$S0067$cluster_label,
        "_c",
        mouse_sobj_list$S0067$individ_clusters
    )

DimPlot(
    mouse_sobj_list$S0067,
    group.by = c("cell_group", "cell_type"),
    label = TRUE,
    label.box = TRUE,
    repel = TRUE
) +
    NoLegend()

Calculate variant calling accuracy in flex data

Any mutation called in the flex data is almost certainly a PCR/sequencing error since this method uses probes. ::: {.cell}

Code
all_flex_files <-
    list.files(
        path = "output/03_test_flex/counts/flex_var_counts_d1",
        pattern = ".txt",
        full.names = TRUE
    )

# In the future, break this down by mt vs non-mt to see if the non-mt are the wierd inaccurate calls ~ 500 - 1000 depth
flex_accuracy <-
    read_tsv(
        all_flex_files,
        id = "sample",
        show_col_types = FALSE,
        col_names = c("chr", "alt", "depth", "count")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        sample = basename(sample) %>%
            str_remove(".txt"),
        alt = if_else(
            alt == ".",
            "ref",
            "variant"
        )
    ) %>%
    group_by(sample, depth, alt) %>%
    summarize(count = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(sample, depth) %>%
    mutate(total_count = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    pivot_wider(
        id_cols = c(sample, depth, total_count),
        names_from = "alt",
        values_from = "count",
        values_fill = 0
    ) %>%
    mutate(perc_wrong = variant / total_count * 100) %>%
    group_by(depth) %>%
    summarize(
        mean_total_count = mean(total_count, na.rm = TRUE),
        mean_perc_wrong = mean(perc_wrong, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(depth != 1)

write_tsv(
    flex_accuracy,
    "output/03_test_flex/counts/flex_accuracy.txt"
)

accuracy_plot <-
    filter(flex_accuracy, depth <= 50) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = depth, y = mean_perc_wrong / 100)) +
    #geom_smooth(alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_point() +
    # geom_text(
    #     data = filter(flex_accuracy, depth <= 10),
    #     aes(label = depth),
    #     nudge_y = 0.00001
    # ) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
    labs(
        title = "Percent Inaccurate Calls by Read Depth",
        x = "Read depth of variant calls",
        y = "% inaccurate variant calls"
    )

ggsave_wrap(
    "output/03_test_flex/figures/flex_accuracy_scatterplot",
    file_type = c("png", "pdf"),
    plot_variable = accuracy_plot,
    width = 6,
    height = 4
)

Downsample GEO samples to one cell and quantify read depth coverage

Run scanBit on individual cells with min_read_depth of 1 to use for read depth and accuracy analysis

For this I’m keeping ten individual cells per cluster, and each cell is assigned to its own cell_group so that I am calculating read depth data for many individual cells. ::: {.cell}

Code
samples_geo <-
    read_tsv("misc/validation_geo_metadata.tsv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    filter(grepl("tumor validation|healthy samples", sample_group)) %>%
    pull(Sample_ID) %>%
    unique()

n_cell_cutoffs <- 1

# Keeping mc.cores low since each run submits 100+ jobs
output <-
    parallel::mclapply(
        samples_geo,
        mc.cores = 2,
        mc.preschedule = FALSE,
        function(this_sample) {
            sobj <-
                qs_read(paste0(
                    "output/01_process_raw/rdata/individual/",
                    this_sample,
                    "_human.qs2"
                ))

            sobj$cell_group <-
                paste0(
                    "clust_",
                    sobj$individ_clusters,
                    "_",
                    sobj$cell_barcode
                )

            Idents(sobj) <- sobj$individ_clusters
            set.seed(1337)
            sobj <- subset(sobj, downsample = 10)

            Idents(sobj) <-
                sobj$cell_group

            scanbit_downsample_loop(
                sobj,
                cutoff_vector = n_cell_cutoffs,
                min_read_depth = c(1, 2, 5, 10, 20),
                out_dir_base = file.path(
                    "output/04_read_depth_analysis/snv/geo",
                    this_sample
                ),
                keep_temp_dir = TRUE,
                sample_label = this_sample,
                ploidy = "GRCh38",
                ref_fasta = "/home/gdrobertslab/lab/GenRef/10x-hg38/fasta/genome.fa"
            )
        }
    )

Calculate the # of positions covered where any cell has a variant

Code
all_var_files <-
    list.files(
        path = "output/04_read_depth_analysis/depths/bcf_depth",
        pattern = "variant_pos",
        full.names = TRUE
    )

var_depths <-
    read_tsv(
        all_var_files,
        id = "cell_sample",
        show_col_types = FALSE,
        skip_empty_rows = FALSE
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        cell_sample = basename(cell_sample) %>%
            str_remove("variant_pos_") %>%
            str_remove(".txt"),
        group = "Variant sites"
    )

ave_var_depths <-
    var_depths %>%
    pivot_wider(
        names_from = "depth",
        values_from = "count",
        values_fill = 0
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
        cols = c(-cell_sample, -group),
        names_to = "depth",
        values_to = "count"
    ) %>%
    group_by(depth) %>%
    summarize(
        mean_count_var = mean(count),
        median_count_var = median(count),
        se_count = sd(count) / sqrt(n()),
        .groups = "drop",
    ) %>%
    mutate(depth = as.numeric(depth)) %>%
    arrange(desc(depth)) %>%
    mutate(cum_count_var = cumsum(mean_count_var)) %>%
    arrange(depth)

write_tsv(
    ave_var_depths,
    "output/04_read_depth_analysis/n_var_count_summary.tsv"
)

Compile all single-cell variant call depths

        mean_count = replace_na(mean_count, 0),
        called_variants = replace_na(called_variants, 0),
        wrong_variants = replace_na(wrong_variants, 0),
        cum_sites_cov = cumsum(mean_count),
        cum_var_sites = cumsum(called_variants),
        cum_wrong_vars = cumsum(wrong_variants)
    ) %>%
    arrange(depth)

write_tsv(
    percent_wrong_table,
    file = "output/04_read_depth_analysis/percent_wrong_table.tsv"
)

    percent_wrong_table %>%

    ggplot(

Calculate how many sites have shared variant information per sample

Code
sbatch analysis_modules/04_read_depth/scripts/count_single_cell_shared_sites.sh
Submitted batch job 8714629
Code
shared_files <-
    list.files(
        path = "output/04_read_depth_analysis/shared",
        pattern = "shared.+\\.txt",
        full.names = TRUE
    )

parse_shared <- function(file_name) {
    dataset <- read_tsv(
        file_name,
        name_repair = "minimal",
        show_col_types = FALSE,
        id = "dataset"
    ) |>
        mutate(
            dataset = str_remove(dataset, ".+shared_") |>
                str_remove(".txt")
        ) |>
        pivot_longer(
            cols = starts_with("clust"),
            names_to = "cell_2",
            values_to = "shared_sites"
        ) |>
        filter(cell_1 != cell_2) |>
        separate(dataset, into = c("sample", "cutoff"), sep = "_") %>%
        mutate(cutoff = factor(cutoff, levels = c("1", "2", "5", "10", "20")))

    return(dataset)
}

shared_sites <-
    lapply(
        shared_files,
        parse_shared
    ) %>%
    bind_rows()

pdf(
    "output/04_read_depth_analysis/figures/shared_sites/shared_sites_heatmaps.pdf",
    width = 10,
    height = 10
)
for (this_sample in unique(shared_sites$sample)) {
    print(shared_sites %>%
        filter(sample == this_sample & cutoff == 1) %>%
        mutate(shared_sites = as.integer(shared_sites)) %>%
        select(cell_1, cell_2, shared_sites) %>%
        pivot_wider(
            names_from = cell_2,
            values_from = shared_sites,
            values_fill = NA
        ) %>%
        column_to_rownames("cell_1") %>%
        as.matrix() %>%
        ComplexHeatmap::pheatmap(
            display_numbers = TRUE,
            fontsize_number = 10,
            number_format =  "%.0f",
            fontsize = 5,
            use_raster = TRUE,
            raster_quality = 4,
            main = paste0(
                "Number of Sites Shared Between Individual Cells for a Subset of Sample ",
                this_sample
            ),
            heatmap_legend_param = list(title = "Shared\nsites")
        ) +
        labs(fill = NULL)
    )
}

I want to look over the merged bcfs and quantify the proportion of positions covered by n reads has a variant call.

Then I want to compare these values between the flex data, where any variant call is artifactual and the B6 data, where an unknown proportion of variant calls at any depth are artifactual. This will allow me to estimate the false positive rate for SNV calls in the pipeline.

Downsample each sample to a range of cells per cluster

This is to test the minimum number of cells/reads needed to accurately identify genetically distinct populations.

Also, I will use the data where I downsample to one cell to calculate coverage provided by one cell on average

Code
source("analysis_modules/06_downsample_analysis/06_helper_functions.R")

Here I am going to downsample the mouse samples to varying number of cells per cluster to run scanBit

This is to test how low we can go while the algorithm still works and provide bcf files to use to quantify coverage per cell in later analyses ::: {.cell}

Code
merged_sobj_mouse_ctrls <-
  qs_read("output/05_mouse_strain/rdata/merged/merged_norm_mouse.qs2")

min_n_cells <- 500

keep_clusters <-
  merged_sobj_mouse_ctrls$cell_group %>%
  table() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  filter(Freq > min_n_cells) %>%
  pull(".")

# Keep only clusters with > min_n_cells cells
merged_sobj_mouse_ctrls <-
  merged_sobj_mouse_ctrls %>%
  subset(cell_group %in% keep_clusters)

# Here, 500000 is forcing us to keep all the cells, so functions as a control
n_cell_cutoffs <- c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 500, 500000)

output <- scanbit_downsample_loop(
  merged_sobj_mouse_ctrls,
  cutoff_vector = n_cell_cutoffs,
  out_dir_base = "output/06_downsample_analysis/snv/mouse/",
  sample_label = "mouse",
  min_read_depth = 10,
  ploidy = "mm10",
  ref_fasta = "/home/gdrobertslab/lab/GenRef/10x-mm10/fasta/genome.fa"
)

Loop over all the GEO human datasets and run scanBit

Code
samples_geo <-
  read_tsv(
    "misc/validation_geo_metadata.tsv",
    show_col_types = FALSE
  ) %>%
  filter(grepl("tumor validation|healthy samples", sample_group)) %>%
  pull(Sample_ID) %>%
  unique()

min_n_cells <- 200

n_cell_cutoffs <- c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 500, 500000)

output <-
  parallel::mclapply(
    samples_geo,
    mc.cores = 5,
    mc.preschedule = FALSE,
    function(this_sample) {
      sobj <-
        qs_read(paste0(
          "output/01_process_raw/rdata/individual/",
          this_sample,
          "_human.qs2"
        ))

      sobj$cell_group <- paste0("clust_", sobj$individ_clusters)

      keep_clusters <-
        sobj$cell_group %>%
        table() %>%
        as.data.frame() %>%
        filter(Freq > min_n_cells) %>%
        pull(".")

      # Keep only clusters with > min_n_cells cells
      sobj <-
        sobj %>%
        subset(cell_group %in% keep_clusters)

      Idents(sobj) <-
        sobj$cell_group

      scanbit_downsample_loop(
        sobj,
        cutoff_vector = n_cell_cutoffs,
        out_dir_base = file.path(
          "output/06_downsample_analysis/snv/geo_samples/",
          this_sample
        ),
        sample_label = this_sample,
        ploidy = "GRCh38",
        min_read_depth = 10,
        ref_fasta = "/home/gdrobertslab/lab/GenRef/10x-hg38/fasta/genome.fa"
      )
    }
  )

rna_per_run <-

    recursive = TRUE,
    full.names = TRUE
  ) %>%
  read_tsv(id = "run") %>%
  select(-cell_barcode, -bam_file) %>%
  mutate(
    run = basename(run) %>%
      str_remove("cell_barcode_table_") %>%
      str_remove("_cells.txt")
  ) %>%
  separate_wider_delim(
    run,
    delim = "_",
    names = c("sample", "cells")
  ) %>%
  mutate(cells = as.numeric(cells)) %>%
  group_by(sample, cells, cell_group) %>%
  summarize(total_umi = sum(nCount_RNA), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(sample, cells) %>%
  summarize(mean_umi = mean(total_umi), .groups = "drop")

sobj_list <- list()
for (this_sample in transgene_samples) {
    sobj_list[[this_sample]] <-
        qs_read(paste0(
            "output/01_process_raw/rdata/individual/",
            this_sample,
            "_mouse.qs2"
        )) %>%
        PercentageFeatureSet(pattern = "^tumor", col.name = "tumor_marker_pct")

    sobj_list[[this_sample]]$cell_group <- paste0(
        sobj_list[[this_sample]]$cluster_label,
        "_c",
        sobj_list[[this_sample]]$individ_clusters
    )

    for (this_cutoff in c(5, 10, 20, 30)) {
        sobj_list[[this_sample]] <- add_snv_group_to_sobj(
            sobj_list[[this_sample]],
            snv_group_file = paste0(
                "output/02_snv_calling/snv/transgene/snvs_",
                this_sample,
                "_",
                this_cutoff,
                "_groups.txt"
            ),
            new_columns = paste0(
                c("snv_group_", "snv_top_lvl_group_"),
                this_cutoff
            ),
            cell_group = "cell_group"
        )
    }

    tumor_markers <-
        grep(
            "^tumor",
            rownames(sobj_list[[this_sample]]),
            value = TRUE
        )

    if (length(tumor_markers) > 0) {
        sobj_list[[this_sample]]$tumor_marker_count <-
            FetchData(
                sobj_list[[this_sample]],
                vars = tumor_markers,
                layer = "counts"
            ) %>%
            rowSums()

        sobj_list[[this_sample]]$tumor_cell <-
            if_else(
                sobj_list[[this_sample]]$tumor_marker_count > 0,
                "Has transgene",
                "No transgene"
            )

        transgene_panel_plot(
            sobj_list[[this_sample]],
            this_sample,
            plot_point_size
        )
    } else {
        sobj_list[[this_sample]] <- NULL
    }
}

ltbc_samples <- c("S0260", "S0261")

plot_point_size <- 0.5

marker_table <-
    parallel::mclapply(
        ltbc_samples,
        mc.cores = 2,
        function(this_sample) {
            sobj <-
                qs_read(paste0(
                    "output/01_process_raw/rdata/individual/",
                    this_sample,
                    "_mouse.qs2"
                ))

            ltbc_table <- gen_cellecta_bc_data(
                paste0(
                    "/home/gdrobertslab/lab/Counts_2/",
                    this_sample,
                    "/possorted_genome_bam.bam"
                ),
                samtools_module = "GCC/9.3.0 SAMtools/1.10", verbose = TRUE
            )

            ltbc_sub <-
                ltbc_table %>%
                mutate(
                    cid = paste0(cid, "-1"),
                    barcode = paste0(lt_14, "_", lt_30),
                    has_barcode = TRUE
                ) %>%
                select(-lt_14, -lt_30) %>%
                group_by(cid) %>%
                mutate(tumor_marker_count = n()) %>%
                slice_head(n = 1) %>%
                column_to_rownames("cid")

            sobj <-
                AddMetaData(
                    sobj,
                    ltbc_sub
                )

            # replace data missing from ltbc_table with values
            sobj$tumor_marker_count <-
                if_else(
                    is.na(sobj$tumor_marker_count),
                    0,
                    sobj$tumor_marker_count
                )

            sobj$has_barcode <-
                if_else(
                    is.na(sobj$has_barcode),
                    FALSE,
                    sobj$has_barcode
                )

            sobj$tumor_cell <-
                if_else(
                    sobj$has_barcode == TRUE,
                    "Has transgene",
                    "No transgene"
                )

            sobj$cell_group <- paste0(
                sobj$cluster_label,
                "_c",
                sobj$individ_clusters
            )

            for (this_cutoff in c(5, 10, 20, 30)) {
                sobj <- add_snv_group_to_sobj(
                    sobj,
                    snv_group_file = paste0(
                        "output/02_snv_calling/snv/transgene/snvs_",
                        this_sample,
                        "_",
                        this_cutoff,
                        "_groups.txt"
                    ),
                    new_columns = paste0(
                        c("snv_group_", "snv_top_lvl_group_"),
                        this_cutoff
                    ),
                    cell_group = "cell_group"
                )
            }

            transgene_panel_plot(
                sobj,
                this_sample,
                plot_point_size
            )

            marker_table <-
                sobj@meta.data %>%
                as_tibble() %>%
                select(
                    Sample_ID,
                    tumor_cell,
                    individ_clusters,
                    cluster_label
                ) %>%
                mutate(
                    cell_group =
                        paste0(
                            cluster_label,
                            "_c",
                            individ_clusters
                        )
                ) %>%
                select(-individ_clusters, cluster_label) %>%
                group_by(Sample_ID, cell_group, tumor_cell) %>%
                summarize(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
                group_by(Sample_ID, cell_group) %>%
                mutate(
                  proportion = n / sum(n),
                  tumor_cell = replace_na(tumor_cell, "No transgene")
                ) %>%
                #filter(tumor_cell == "Has transgene") %>%
                arrange(desc(proportion))

            return(marker_table)
        }
    ) %>%
    bind_rows()

write_tsv(
    marker_table,
    "output/07_known_tumors/snv/transgene/transgene_tumor_clust_ltbc.txt"
)

                group_by(Sample_ID, individ_clusters) %>%
                summarize(
                    mean_ncount = mean(nCount_RNA),
                    median_ncount = median(nCount_RNA),
                    sum_ncount = sum(nCount_RNA),
                    .groups = "drop"
                )
        }
    ) %>%
    bind_rows()

Make a pdf for supplemental figure showing all human validation trees

Code
tree_table <-
    tibble(
        downsample_pdfs =
            list.files(
                path = "output/02_snv_calling/snv/human",
                pattern = "*_10_tree.pdf",
                full.names = TRUE
            )
    )

tree_table$sample <-
    tree_table$downsample_pdfs %>%
    str_remove(".+snvs_") %>%
    str_remove("_.+")

pdf(
    "output/08_human_validation/figures/combined_human_validation_trees.pdf",
    width = 6,
    height = 15
)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(tree_table))) {
    sobj <-
        qs_read(paste0(
            "output/01_process_raw/rdata/individual/",
            tree_table$sample[i],
            "_human.qs2"
        ))
    tree <-
        ggplot2::ggplot() +
        ggpubr::background_image(
            magick::image_read(tree_table$downsample_pdfs[i], density = 300)
        ) +
        ggplot2::coord_fixed() +
        ggplot2::labs(
            title = paste0(
                "Sample: ",
                tree_table$sample[i]
            )
        ) +
        theme(plot.margin = margin(10, 0, 10, 0, "pt"))

    dimplot_clusters <-
        DimPlot(
            sobj,
            group.by = "individ_clusters",
            label = TRUE,
            label.box = TRUE,
            repel = TRUE,
            label.size = 1.5
        ) +
        NoLegend() +
        labs(title = "Transcriptional Clusters") +
        theme(plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10, "pt"))

    dimplot_celltypes <-
        DimPlot(
            sobj,
            group.by = "cell_type",
            label = TRUE,
            label.box = TRUE,
            repel = TRUE,
            label.size = 1.5
        ) +
        NoLegend() +
        labs(title = "Cell Type Annotations") +
        theme(plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10, "pt"))

    # Merge the three plots
    print(
        gridExtra::grid.arrange(
            grobs = list(tree, dimplot_clusters, dimplot_celltypes)
        )
    )
    rm(sobj, tree, dimplot_clusters, dimplot_celltypes)
}

source("analysis_modules/10_cmp_other_methods/10_helper_functions.R")

Read in scevan results

Code
read_tsv(
  list.files(
    "output/10_cmp_other_methods/scevan_results",
    pattern = "_scevan_results.tsv",
    full.names = TRUE
  ),
  id = "sample",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    sample = str_remove(sample, "_scevan_results.tsv") %>%
      str_remove(".+/")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    scevan_call = class,
    cell = barcode
  ) %>%
  select(-confidentNormal) %>%
  write_tsv(
    "output/10_cmp_other_methods/scevan_results/compiled_scevan_output.tsv"
  )

Read in scatomic results

Code
read_tsv(
  list.files(
    "output/10_cmp_other_methods/scatomic_results",
    pattern = "_scatomic_results.tsv",
    full.names = TRUE
  ),
  id = "sample",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    sample = str_remove(sample, "_scatomic_results.tsv") %>%
      str_remove(".+/")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    scatomic_call = pan_cancer_cluster,
    cell = barcode
  ) %>%
  select(sample, cell, scatomic_call) %>%
  write_tsv(
    "output/10_cmp_other_methods/scatomic_results/compiled_scatomic_output.tsv"
  )

Read in numbat results

Code
numbat_files <- list.files(
  path = "output/10_cmp_other_methods/numbat_results/rdata",
  pattern = "^clone_post_2.tsv$",
  recursive = TRUE,
  full.names = TRUE
)

numbat_results <- tibble(sample = character())
for (this_file in numbat_files) {
  numbat_results <-
    read_tsv(
      this_file,
      id = "sample",
      show_col_types = FALSE,
      col_select = c(cell, sample, compartment_opt)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      sample = str_remove(sample, ".+rdata/") %>%
        str_remove("/output/clone_post_2.tsv")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(numbat_call = compartment_opt) %>%
    bind_rows(numbat_results)
}

Merge all the human outputs together

Code
call_files <- c(
  "output/10_cmp_other_methods/scevan_results/compiled_scevan_output.tsv",
  "output/10_cmp_other_methods/scatomic_results/compiled_scatomic_output.tsv",
  "output/10_cmp_other_methods/numbat_results/compiled_numbat_output.tsv",
  "output/10_cmp_other_methods/copykat_results/compiled_copykat_output.tsv",
  "output/10_cmp_other_methods/infercna_results/compiled_infercna_output.tsv",
  "output/10_cmp_other_methods/scanbit_results/snv_tumor_calls.txt"
)

all_calls <-
  lapply(call_files, function(x) read_tsv(x, show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
  purrr::reduce(function(x, y) full_join(x, y, by = c("cell", "sample"))) %>%
  mutate(
    scevan_call = str_replace(scevan_call, "normal", "Normal") %>%
      str_replace("tumor", "Tumor") %>%
      str_replace("filtered", "Unassigned") %>%
      replace_na("Unassigned"),
    scatomic_call = str_replace(scatomic_call, "Cancer", "Tumor") %>%
      replace_na("Unassigned"),
    numbat_call = str_replace(numbat_call, "normal", "Normal") %>%
      str_replace("tumor", "Tumor") %>%
      replace_na("Unassigned"),
    copykat_call = str_replace(copykat_call, "aneuploid", "Tumor") %>%
      str_replace("diploid", "Normal") %>%
      str_replace("not.defined", "Unassigned") %>%
      replace_na("Unassigned"),
    infercna_call = str_replace(infercna_call, "nonmalignant", "Normal") %>%
      str_replace("malignant", "Tumor") %>%
      str_replace("unassigned", "Unassigned") %>%
      replace_na("Unassigned"),
    scanBit_call = str_replace(scanBit_call, "normal", "Normal") %>%
      str_replace("tumor", "Tumor") %>%
      str_replace("unknown", "Unassigned") %>%
      replace_na("Unassigned")
  )

write_tsv(
  all_calls,
  "output/10_cmp_other_methods/all_calls.tsv"
)

human_calls <- read_tsv("output/10_cmp_other_methods/human_calls.tsv")

human_sample_metadata <- read_tsv(
  "misc/validation_geo_metadata.tsv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

human_samples <-
  human_sample_metadata %>%
  dplyr::filter(align_ref == "/home/gdrobertslab/lab/GenRef/10x-hg38") %>%
  pull("Sample_ID") %>%
  unique()

title_key <- list(
  "scevan_call" = "SCEVAN",
  "scatomic_call" = "SCATOMIC",
  "numbat_call" = "Numbat",
  "copykat_call" = "CopyKAT",
  "infercna_call" = "InferCNA",
  "scanBit_call" = "ScanBit",
  "cell_type" = "Cell Type"
)

color_key <- list(
  "Normal" = plot_cols[2],
  "Tumor" = plot_cols[1],
  "Unassigned" = plot_cols[5],
  "top_lvl_group0" = plot_cols[4],
  "top_lvl_group1" = plot_cols[3]
)

for (this_sample in human_samples) {
  message("Processing sample: ", this_sample)

  this_metadata <-
    human_sample_metadata %>%
    dplyr::filter(Sample_ID == this_sample)

  sobj <- qs_read(
    paste0(
      "output/01_process_raw/rdata/individual/",
      this_sample,
      "_human.qs2"
    )
  ) %>%
    AddMetaData(
      human_calls %>%
        dplyr::filter(sample == this_sample) %>%
        column_to_rownames("cell") %>%
        dplyr::select(
          -sample,
          -sample_group,
          -tumor_type,
          -n_cells,
          -pattern_id,
          -cell_order
        )
    )

  image_list <-
    lapply(
      c(
        "scevan_call",
        "scatomic_call",
        "numbat_call",
        "copykat_call",
        "infercna_call",
        "scanBit_call",
        "cell_type"
      ),
      function(x) {
        use_colors <- color_key[names(color_key) %in% sobj@meta.data[[x]]]
        plot_obj <- DimPlot(
          sobj,
          group.by = x,
          repel = TRUE,
          pt.size = 0.5
        ) +
          labs(title = title_key[[x]]) +
          theme(
            legend.position = "bottom",
            axis.text.x = element_blank(),
            axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
            axis.text.y = element_blank(),
            axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
          )

        if (x != "cell_type") {
          plot_obj <- plot_obj + scale_color_manual(values = use_colors)
        } else {
          plot_obj <-
            LabelClusters(plot_obj, id = "cell_type", box = TRUE) +
            theme(legend.position = "none")
        }

        return(plot_obj)
      }
    )

  plot_layout <- "
    ABC
    DEF
    GGG
    GGG
  "

  ggsave(
    file = paste0(
      "output/10_cmp_other_methods/figures/dimplots/",
      this_sample,
      ".pdf"
    ),
    plot = patchwork::wrap_plots(image_list, design = plot_layout) +
      plot_annotation(
        title = "Tumor Identification Method Comparison",
        subtitle = paste0(
          "Sample: ",
          this_sample,
          ": ",
          this_metadata$description[1]
        )
      ),
    width = 10,
    height = 15
  )
  rm(sobj, image_list)
}

min_transgene_prop <- 0.2

tumor_ids <-
  bind_rows(
    read_tsv(
      "output/07_known_tumors/snv/transgene/transgene_tumor_clust_ltbc.txt",
      show_col_types = FALSE
    ),
    read_tsv(
      "output/07_known_tumors/snv/transgene/transgene_tumor_clust.txt",
      show_col_types = FALSE
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    tumor_cell = replace_na(tumor_cell, "no_transgene") %>%
      str_replace("Has transgene", "has_transgene")
  ) %>%
  select(-n) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = tumor_cell,
    values_from = proportion,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    actual_state = if_else(
      has_transgene >= min_transgene_prop,
      "Tumor",
      "Normal"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(Sample_ID, cell_group, actual_state) %>%
  dplyr::rename(cluster_label = cell_group, sample = Sample_ID)

sample_cluster_table <-
  lapply(
    unique(tumor_ids$sample),
    function(x) {
      qs_read(paste0(
        "output/01_process_raw/rdata/individual/",
        x,
        "_mouse.qs2"
      )) %>%
        .[[]] %>%
        select(cell_barcode, cluster_label, individ_clusters, Sample_ID)
    }
  ) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  mutate(cluster_label = paste0(cluster_label, "_c", individ_clusters)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    cell = cell_barcode,
    sample = Sample_ID
  ) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  left_join(tumor_ids, by = c("sample", "cluster_label")) %>%
  select(sample, cell, actual_state)

mouse_samples <-
  tumor_ids$sample %>%
  unique()

mouse_calls <-

    "output/10_cmp_other_methods/all_calls.tsv",
    show_col_types = FALSE

  filter(sample %in% mouse_samples) %>%

  group_by(sample) %>%
  order_cells(
